dedupe_keys.name: escenarios de cambio climatico por cuenca

description: Escenarios de cambio climático por cuenca is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Ecología y Cambio Climático (INECC). Los datos que se encontrarán en éste aparatado son los escenarios de cambio climático agregado en las 757 cuencas hidrológicas de México. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto Nacional de Ecología y Cambio Climático (INECC). Its tags are agua río, alteración climática, calentamiento tierra, clima, condición climática. It offers 20 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-05-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
